name: Attio
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Attio, model contacts and companies flexibly, create views, and manage a pipeline. The hard boundary is real-time data model, enrichment, email sync, automations, and collaborative polish, plus integrations, data quality, and workflow lock-in.
